title: Area-code shard C pass 26 — 707 / 713 / 719

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 707, 713, and 719?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public-person role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, residence, or public role.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Arcata and Eureka Food Not Bombs are current through first-party/current January 2026 reporting. Cooperation Humboldt was reviewed but not promoted as active because Black Humboldt reports its nonprofit infrastructure transferred after a nearly two-year strategic hiatus. Turnip is retained only as a source-scoped public alias for a quoted Arcata volunteer.

Houston Food Not Bombs and Space City Anarchist Organization are existing canonical identities reused rather than duplicated. Both have current first-party public activity. Space City explicitly self-describes as anarchist and states it has no leaders; no leader identity is invented. Benjamin Franklin is source-scoped due extreme name-collision risk.

Food to Power currently operates Colorado Springs food-access programs and publishes a 719 phone number; Patience Kabwasa is publicly listed as Executive Director. 50501 Colorado Springs maintains current mutual-aid and cross-platform public communication surfaces; Shawn Maddox is directly identified in 2026 reporting as a public organizer.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public-person enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 707, 713, and 719.
